name: SiteWatchman
author: adminkov

sections.description:
Website administration and control of user visits.

Features include:

  • Advanced control of site visits and user actions.
  • File editor for key system files (index.php, robots.txt, .htaccess, wp-config.php).
  • Comprehensive management of WordPress wp-cron tasks.
  • Geolocation and detailed traffic statistics.

Privacy Notice & External Services

This plugin uses third-party API services to process geolocation data based on IP addresses (determining the visitor’s country and city). Depending on the administrator’s selection in the plugin settings, data may be sent to one of the following services:

  1. IP-API (https://ip-api.com) – Privacy Policy: https://ip-api.com
  2. IPinfo (https://ipinfo.io) – Privacy Policy: https://ipinfo.io
  3. IpApi (https://ipapi.co) – Privacy Policy: https://ipapi.co
  4. Geobytes (https://geobytes.com) – Privacy Policy: https://geobytes.com

Plotting website visit graphs:
* Google Maps/Google Earth Additional Terms of Service: https://www.google.com/help/terms_maps/
* Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sitewatchman folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to SiteWatchman -> Settings to configure your security metrics and set up the console passphrase.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release. Core visitor logging, attack analyzer, and secure web console implementation.
